My Projects

Vehicle Dynamics · Apex Racing Team

Electric Race Car

Head of Vehicle Dynamics

Built a formula-style electric race car from scratch. As Head of Vehicle Dynamics, I was responsible for designing the suspension, steering, and braking systems — analyzing them in SolidWorks, manufacturing the parts, and integrating them with the electrical and chassis teams. Every component had to survive competition conditions while meeting strict performance specs.

02
Underwater Robotics · Sailfish ROV

Underwater ROV

Software Head

Developed the full software stack for an underwater remotely operated vehicle that dives to perform specific tasks. I built a control system using ROS 2 Jazzy on Raspberry Pi, integrated IMU and pressure sensors for stable navigation, and built a GUI that gives the co-pilot full real-time control of the system. I also developed AI computer vision models to help the co-pilot complete underwater perception tasks autonomously.

🏆 Best Maneuverable ROV — MATE ROV Egypt 2024 🥇 1st Place — GRC Saudi Arabia 2025

03
Oceanographic Instrument · Sailfish ROV

Vertical Float

Software Head

Designed and developed the software for a vertical float instrument used to measure pressure, depth, and temperature from the sea during dive profiles — both descending and ascending. I built an IoT and control system on ESP32, developed a linear regression model to control the buoyancy profiles, and implemented ESP-NOW for wireless data transmission. The collected data is then analyzed and visualized as real-time graphs for scientific use.

ESP32ESP-NOW IoTLinear Regression Pressure SensorsData Visualization
04
Competitive Robotics

RoboSoccer Robot

Software Head

Built a robot that plays soccer — competing against other robots on a field. The robot features a pneumatic mechanism to kick the ball with precision. As Software Head, I was responsible for controlling the motors and the pneumatic kicking mechanism using ESP32 and Bluetooth, giving the operator smooth, low-latency control during matches. The robot was designed to respond quickly and accurately under real competition conditions.

05
Industrial Automation · HA Consulting & Don Bosco

PLC Programming

Automation Engineer Trainee

Across two training programs at HA Consulting Group and Don Bosco Institute, I programmed five different PLC platforms — Siemens, Schneider, FATEK, Delta, and KINCO. I used Siemens TIA Portal with Function Blocks, Function Calls, and Data Blocks to build structured automation logic, simulated processes in Factory IO, and configured Variable Frequency Drives for motor speed control. At Don Bosco, the capstone project integrated a Siemens PLC, VFD, and HMI into a complete sensor-driven motor control system.

06
Electrical Control · HA Consulting

Classic Control

Automation Engineer Trainee

Built and wired real control panels using classic electrical components — contactors, relays, timers, circuit breakers, and push buttons. I designed and assembled motor control circuits including forward/reverse, star-delta starting, and sequential control logic from scratch. Working with actual hardware taught me how real industrial control systems are constructed and protected before any PLC gets involved.
